decisions.reason: The condenser fits the core air-cooled portfolio, and the firm is growing with slack, so there is no performance shortfall to trigger dropping it, though its overlap with C and the withdrawal of the similar Product A keep the consolidation risk modest.
As a near-duplicate of B it remains the more likely rationalisation candidate, but with growth and no reported shortfall management is likely to keep carrying it.
The tube liner supports the strategic lifecycle-service business at low marginal cost and likely meets aspirations, so it is retained.
The customized multi-model air cooler line embodies the firm's integrated-solutions strategy and spreads risk, making withdrawal very unlikely.
The tube end repair inserts strengthen aftermarket service revenue with little resource use, so there is no pressure to drop them while the firm expands.
